This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P1, which 
must be performed 
every five years as 
indicated by Y5 in the above title block

This Pump transfers raw water 
from Nile to the water treatment plant .

The first draft is initiated 
and tested by eng. Mohammed Abd El Kader, reviewed by maintenance manager 
eng. Mohammed Farag, revised by EDEPC inspection & quality 
control eng. Abouda Elbana, approved by eng. Awad Fathy: head 
sector of Talkha 2x210MW 
power station, 
and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC inspection & quality control 
head sector.

A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,

Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks must be surrounding the work area is required,

Wear safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc

Isolate the circuit 
 breaker for motor of this pump.

The pump 
 must be isolated mechanically by closing suction and delivery valves 
 and drain it.
Be sure pump must be completely drainage.

Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller.
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator.
Vibrometer, Straight edge, Rugs.

Check discharge quantity and pressure and 
 record them.

Check the vibration level of the pump set 
 complete with the motor then, record them.
Measure the pump alignment and record it.
Unscrew motor bolts and take it out.

Measure the axial clearance of the pump and 
 record it .

Unscrew the shaft end nut and take the pump 
 half-coupling out.
Dismantle the attached pipes.
Dismount the gland and take packing cords out.

Dismount thrust bearing (7210/T) complete with 
 the hanger.

Dismantle discharge elbow and shaft guide 
 pipes.

Dismantle the shaft joints by unscrewing them 
 from their mafe couplings.

Dismantle suction lantern if used, then take 
 suction slide radial bearing (2209) out.

Begin dismantles the hydraulic part from 
 suction.

Dismantle impellers, sleeves and diffusers 
 from the hydraulic part shaft after dismantling the pump clamping bolts.

The validity of the anti-friction bearings ( 
 thrust radial ) .

Check the radial clearances for pump by 
 measuring the gap between wearing rings of diffusers and the distance sleeves 
 on the shaft and records it.
Check all parts for any worn-out.
Check all parts for cracks.
Inspect the run-out of shafts.

Install diffusers, sleeves, and impellers from 
 the discharge side up to suction side and tight them with the clamping bolts.

Insert shaft in the suction slide bearing with 
 lantern and check radial and axial clearance of the pump and ensure that pump 
 rotate easily, otherwise dismount and treat the causes.

Install the shaft joints with their mafe 
 couplings,
Mount the shaft guide pipes.

Install the hanger complete with discharge 
 elbow into shaft guide pipes.
Mount the stuffing box with gland.
Mount the thrust bearing and cover it.
Install the pump half coupling.

Lift the pump by crane and put it in its 
 place.
Fix the pump and tight all attached pipes.

Install packing cords and tight gland bolts 
 easily.

Adjust the axial clearance of the pump by a 
 value equal to one half of all axial clearance, by the nut.
Mount the electric motor.

Adjust the alignment between motor shaft and 
 pump shaft and record them.

Check the oil 
 level in the thrust-bearing pump bath

Open the cooling 
 water for the oil bath of the thrust bearing.

Open the suction 
 and delivery valves of the pump.

Check the 
 direction of rotation of the pump by pushing the electric button of the motor pump instantaneously.

The temperature 
 of the anti-friction bearing (it should be not exceed 75C).

The temperature 
 of cooling water.

Any water leakage 
 and oil leakage.

The discharge 
 quantity and pressures (suction and discharge) of the pump and record 
 them.

Check the 
 vibration level and record it.

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P1, which 
must be performed 
every five years as 
indicated by Y5 in the above title block
This Pump transfers raw water 
from Nile to the water treatment plant .
The first draft is initiated 
and tested by eng. Mohammed Abd El Kader, reviewed by maintenance manager 
eng. Mohammed Farag, revised by EDEPC inspection & quality 
control eng. Abouda Elbana, approved by eng. Awad Fathy: head 
sector of Talkha 2x210MW 
power station, 
and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC inspection & quality control 
head sector.
Technical 
specification
Type of pump 125 CVEV 
265 
15 / 2LN
Design: 
Vertical centrifugal pump
Pump capacity 75.6 
m3/h (21 L/s)
Specific energy 35 m 
W.C. (345 J/kg)
Pump Speed 1480 
r.p.m.
Bearing Type 7210/T 
- 2209
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence

Wear safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc

Be sure pump must be completely drainage.

Work to be Carried Out
Disassembly
Pump 
In Operation

Pump Out Of Operation

Begin dismantles the hydraulic part from

Inspection
The validity of the anti-friction bearings ( 
 thrust radial ) .
Check the radial clearances for pump by 
 measuring the gap between wearing rings of diffusers and the distance sleeves 
 on the shaft and records it.
Check all parts for any worn-out.
Check all parts for cracks.
Inspect the run-out of shafts.
Assembly
Install diffusers, sleeves, and impellers from

Mount the shaft guide pipes.
Install the hanger complete with discharge

Mount the stuffing box with gland.
Mount the thrust bearing and cover it.
Install the pump half coupling.
Lift the pump by crane and put it in its

Fix the pump and tight all attached pipes.
Install packing cords and tight gland bolts 
 easily.

Mount the electric motor.
Adjust the alignment between motor shaft and 
 pump shaft and record them.
Starting the Pump
Check the oil

Open the cooling 
 water for the oil bath of the thrust bearing.
Open the suction 
 and delivery valves of the pump.
Check the

During Operation
The temperature

Any water leakage

Check the
